description:
Define the follow-on operational safeguards after automated monetization test hardening.

This should plan:
- anomaly logging and alerting for suspicious payment or entitlement behavior
- reconciliation between successful payments and granted service/access
- operator-visible signals for failed fulfillment or duplicate delivery
- manual review and recovery hooks for customer support
- the dashboards or evidence needed before monetization scales

Goal: after automated assurance is stronger, LPBS gains peace-of-mind operational guardrails for real revenue flow.
name: lpbs-payment-guardrails-and-reconciliation-plan
title: Plan LPBS Payment Guardrails And Reconciliation
